name: reaching up shoulder stretch
description: Reaching overhead to stretch the shoulders and the sides of the upper body.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Reach one or both arms overhead and up as high as you can, then press them slightly backward.
Do not arch your lower back as you reach.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
